engineeringSkip.reason: Nuclear pasta is a real but purely astrophysical state of matter that exists only under neutron-star gravity, cannot be manufactured or engineered on Earth, and its claimed use as an ultra-dense structural material has no basis in known physics.

factCheck.reason: Nuclear pasta is a real, well-studied phase of matter predicted to exist in the crusts of neutron stars, but it only forms under the crushing gravity inside those stars and is an object of astrophysics and simulation, not something that can be manufactured, extracted or engineered into a material.
